llm_fields.description: The scheme assists Scheduled Caste leather artisans in establishing their own showrooms or mobile vans to sell products directly to consumers, providing a location‑based subsidy.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be leather artisans belonging to specified Scheduled Caste sub‑castes, be at least 18 years old, have an annual family income not exceeding ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas, not have received benefits from other schemes (except training), and have no family members employed in government or semi‑government organisations.
